note: Hand-picked by Claude from your travel history – regenerate any time by asking in a session.

suggestions.name: Kyoto & the Nakasendo (Kiso Valley)
suggestions.reason: You love a rail journey and great food – walk the old post-road between mountain towns by train and on foot.

suggestions.name: Tbilisi & Svaneti
suggestions.reason: The Caucasus is the wilder cousin of your Albania and Uzbekistan trips – ancient towers, big trekking, and natural wine.

suggestions.name: Petra & Wadi Rum
suggestions.reason: You glimpsed the River Jordan from the West Bank – the country itself rewards with rose-rock canyons and desert camps like your Sahara nights.

suggestions.name: Seoul & Jeju Island
suggestions.reason: A food-obsessed megacity plus a volcanic island to ferry out to – your kind of city-and-coast combo.

suggestions.name: Taipei & Taroko Gorge
suggestions.reason: Night-market feasts then marble-walled gorge hikes – a tidy mix of the things you gravitate to in Asia.

suggestions.name: Sossusvlei & Etosha (self-drive)
suggestions.reason: You like a road trip and you've done the Sahara – swap it for red dunes and a self-drive safari.

suggestions.name: Song-Köl & the Tien Shan
suggestions.reason: Yurts, horses and high passes – the natural next step after the Aral Sea and Samarkand.

suggestions.name: Rio & Chapada Diamantina
suggestions.reason: The big gap in an otherwise complete South America – beach city energy plus waterfall-and-plateau trekking.

suggestions.name: Salar de Uyuni & La Paz
suggestions.reason: The mirror-flat salt desert is an easy, spectacular add to your Andean run through Peru, Chile and Argentina.

suggestions.name: Stockholm & the archipelago
suggestions.reason: Nordic design city plus thousands of islands to ferry between – like the Greek isles, but pine and timber.

suggestions.name: Palawan & Siargao
suggestions.reason: Island-hopping, lagoons and reefs to follow the Maldives and Indonesia – barefoot and boat-bound.

suggestions.name: Lalibela & the Simien Mountains
suggestions.reason: Rock-hewn churches and gelada-dotted highlands – deeply off the beaten track, the way you like Africa.

suggestions.name: Kathmandu & the Annapurna foothills
suggestions.reason: Himalayan trekking with the same pull as El Chaltén and Theth – teahouse trails and giant peaks.

suggestions.name: The Gobi & Orkhon Valley
suggestions.reason: Overland across the steppe, sleeping in gers – remote and road-trippy, a true frontier after Central Asia.
